issue_title: Performance below 85 on 3 pages: homepage LCP trending up, screenshot-to-primevue hits 4780 ms
issue_body:
# Performance regression — 3 pages persistently below 85

## Affected pages

| Page | Performance | LCP | TBT | vs. previous |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `/` | 78 | 4267 ms | 240 ms | perf −4, LCP +500 ms |
| `/projects/note-structurer` | 79 | 4336 ms | 203 ms | stable |
| `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` | 76 | 4780 ms | 189 ms | perf −4, LCP +536 ms |

## Context
- The homepage has now dropped from 88 → 82 → 78 across the last three nightly audits.
- `/projects/screenshot-to-primevue` has the highest LCP on the site (4780 ms) after a +536 ms increase overnight.
- All accessibility, best-practices, and SEO scores remain 100. No visual breakage detected on any page.

## Recommended fixes (single highest-impact area)
1. **Preload the LCP element** on each affected page with `<link rel="preload" as="image" fetchpriority="high">` (or `as="fetch"` for inline hero content).
2. **Serve hero/demo images as WebP** at their display dimensions to cut transfer size.
3. **Code-split or defer non-critical JS** — homepage and note-structurer TBT (~200–240 ms) is contributing to the performance penalty.

## Not affected
- `/about` (87) and `/projects` (88) are stable above the 85 threshold.
- No visual or structural breakage on any page (desktop or mobile).
